title: COUNTERGEDI: A controllable approach to generate polite, detoxified and emotional counterspeech
measurement_description: The paper evaluates the generation of controlled (polite, detoxified, emotional) counterspeech in response to hate speech. A portion of the hate speech examples and one of the datasets used (CONAN) specifically target religious groups, measuring the model's ability to generate appropriate responses to Islamophobic and anti-Semitic content.
findings: The proposed method, COUNTERGEDI, can successfully generate counterspeech with controlled attributes (e.g., politeness, joy, anger) in response to religious hate speech, such as anti-Semitic and Islamophobic comments. The method improves attribute scores significantly without deteriorating the relevance of the generated response.
